The skill analyzes with derivatives, monotonic intervals, extrema, limits, and value ranges, then rewrites the final proof using concrete point selection, sign changes, continuity, and the intermediate value theorem. In teaching mode, explain where chosen points come from using tangent bounds, exponential/log inequalities, Taylor-style estimates, quadratic fitting, homomorphic transformations, or explicit threshold solving.
skills.description_zh:
